ruling.recommended_action: Route to human reviewer: pull the full chat thread around rider message #1 (09:35) to clear or act on the SAFE-1 keyword hit; if benign, apply the unexempted-segment distance refund of $1.09 (0.77 km × $1.41/km) under RD-2. Do not add an account flag (RD-6 predicate not met).
ruling.escalation_reason: SAFE-1 trigger: chat-threat keyword detected in the rider's message (F8, on rider message #1 at 09:35, F7). Automatic adjudication under RD-2 is barred; case referred to a human reviewer with the factual summary below.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 09:49–09:52: 2.15 km driven vs 1.38 km optimal, +0.77 km, straying up to 1019 m from the optimal route [F3]. Not exempted by RD-5: consent requires a driver-proposed route named before leaving the optimal route and rider agreement before the segment start, and the chat shows only the rider's 09:35 lobby message plus the driver's post-hoc statement (F7, F9) [RD-5]. Not exempted by RD-4: no traffic incident on the substituted optimal stretch (F12) and only band 4 (30–39 km/h) records not matched to that stretch (F10, F11), above the band 1–2 threshold [RD-4]. Not a rider-named stop under RD-3 [RD-1].

rejected_claims.reason: The full +1.6 km / 12.4 km billed excess (F1, F6) is not refundable: RD-2 refunds only the unexempted segment's extra_km, and the actual-vs-optimal gap exceeds the 0.77 km segment (F3) by 0.83 km of non-refundable map-matching residue [F1][F3][F6][RD-2]. The claim is otherwise accepted as to RydeTAXI being meter-based.

Not rejected in substance: the 09:49–09:52 record (F3) is an unexempted off-route segment under RD-1, but the resulting refund is capped at that segment's own 0.77 km [F3][RD-1][RD-2], and no amount is awarded in this escalated ruling [SAFE-1].

Accepted: no chat or app record shows a pre-departure route proposal and rider agreement (F7 is a lobby message, F9 is the driver's post-hoc statement), so RD-5 consent fails and the segment is not exempted [F7][F9][RD-5].

Accepted: RD-4 affords no excuse — F12 records no traffic incidents, and F10/F11 show only band 4 (30–39 km/h), above the band 1–2 threshold and not matched to the substituted optimal stretch [F10][F11][F12][RD-4].

Arithmetic correct but not actionable here: 0.77 km × $1.41/km (= $17.47 ÷ 12.4 km) = $1.09 is the right RD-2 figure, withheld only because SAFE-1 bars automatic adjudication [F3][F4][F6][RD-2][SAFE-1].
Accepted: the 0.83 km gap between the billed 1.6 km excess (F1, F4) and the 0.77 km segment (F3) is map-matching residual and is not refunded under RD-2 [F1][F3][F4][RD-2].

Refused (withdrawn by the rider): RD-6 requires an upheld route dispute in the last 90 days, and F15 shows 0 route disputes upheld for the driver (the 2 upheld disputes are not route-based); profile facts cannot establish the RD-6 predicate on their own [F15][RD-6].

Rejected as an exemption defence: band 4 (30–39 km/h) on the Ayer Rajah and Central Expressways (F10, F11) is not band 1–2 severe congestion and is not tied to the substituted 1.38 km optimal stretch; F12 confirms no incident, so RD-4(a) and (b) both fail [F10][F11][F12][RD-4].

Rejected as to the disputed distance component: the $1.09 of metered distance inside the unexempted 09:49–09:52 segment (F3) is not a legitimate component for the driver to retain under RD-2, even though the other published meter components stand [F3][F6][RD-2].
Accepted: no account flag is warranted — RD-6's 'repeated' predicate is absent (F15: 0 route deviations upheld in 90 days) [F15][RD-6].
